audienceSummary: Marriott Hotels targets guests aligned with Bleisure, Group / MICE, International Inbound. Evaluate demand behavior in each target market rather than generic chain-loyalty averages or parent-platform assumptions.

valueCreationScenarios.title: Full-Service Gateway Conversion
valueCreationScenarios.summary: Marriott Hotels fits owners converting capable full-service assets in business and leisure gateways when meetings space, rooms product, and service depth can carry the flagship promise without drifting into JW luxury or soft-brand collection positioning.

valueCreationScenarios.title: Meetings And Group Demand Capture
valueCreationScenarios.summary: Assets with credible meeting and group capacity create Marriott Hotels value when owners underwrite banquet, staffing, and public-space capital honestly so affiliation lift matches the property’s real group demand profile.

valueCreationScenarios.title: Business-Leisure Mixed Market Play
valueCreationScenarios.summary: Mixed-demand urban and resort corridors suit Marriott Hotels when transient and leisure demand can share a full-service plant—owners should price operating intensity against Sheraton or Westin alternatives before locking the flag.

valueCreationScenarios.title: Standards-Led Reflag Confidence
valueCreationScenarios.summary: Independent or legacy full-service hotels gain Marriott Hotels owner confidence when PIP scope, systems cutover, and Bonvoy readiness are sequenced clearly and the asset can stay brand-legible after conversion.

scenarios.title: Flagship Full-Service Repositioning
scenarios.summary: Marriott Hotels creates owner value on full-service conversions and new builds where guests expect a namesake brand experience—meetings capability, polished public space, and consistent service—not a corporate brochure story. Underwrite product and staffing to the flagship lane, and keep JW Marriott, Autograph, and Tribute out of the same diligence file. Value weakens when the asset cannot sustain full-service depth or when owners treat Marriott International as the brand itself.

scenarios.title: Meetings-Capable Urban And Resort Assets
scenarios.summary: Owner value rises when Marriott Hotels affiliation supports group and bleisure demand the physical plant can actually host. Diligence meeting inventory, F&B capacity, and operator depth before modeling commercial lift. CALA references such as Cancún and Mexico City help owners benchmark product and service scope against regional competitors rather than US-only comps.

scenarios.title: Network Reach With Brand-Specific Underwriting
scenarios.summary: Marriott Bonvoy and Marriott International distribution strengthen the commercial case only when the hotel can deliver Marriott Hotels standards day one. Sequence systems, training, and PIP with financing so affiliation does not outrun product readiness. Compare explicitly to Sheraton and Westin when the asset’s wellness, legacy, or meeting profile points to a sibling lane.

geographicFootprint.title: Caribbean & Latin America
geographicFootprint.summary: CALA remains a primary diligence region for Marriott Hotels with named operating examples such as Marriott Cancun Resort and Mexico City Marriott Reforma. Owners should use these hotels to test full-service product, meetings readiness, and guest-experience delivery in regional demand corridors.

geographicFootprint.title: North America
geographicFootprint.summary: North America is a core Marriott Hotels operating theater for business gateways and mixed-demand markets. Owners evaluating US or Canada assets should underwrite meetings depth and service intensity against local competitive sets while keeping the brand distinct from JW and soft-brand peers.

geographicFootprint.title: Europe
geographicFootprint.summary: European Marriott Hotels placements suit owners needing flagship full-service recognition in capital and gateway cities. Treat Europe as International Reference evidence unless a specific CALA-comparable corridor is under review, and confirm the asset can carry full-service standards.
